micro_interactions.hover: Subtle -translate-y-1 and shadow increase for all cards
micro_interactions.active: Tactile active:scale-95 for all buttons and Kanban cards to mimic physical pressing
micro_interactions.status_change: Animate layout changes using framer-motion (e.g. layoutId or simple layout prop) when moving cards between columns
micro_interactions.add_to_order: Spring animation pop on the cart icon/badge when an item is added

testing.rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, order cards, menu items) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute based on role. e.g., data-testid='order-submit-button', data-testid='kanban-card-123'.

images.description: Warm pine wood cabin interior with stove, perfectly matches the Chhaon Instagram aesthetic. Use as a blurred/dimmed background for login, or soft background for empty states.
Cabin window view during winter. Good for secondary onboarding screens or hero banner within admin settings.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize mobile-first view: the POS needs to be operated by a volunteer holding a phone. Touch targets must be at least 48px.
Do not use generic SaaS Purple or Blue. Stick strictly to the Sage Green (#8A9A86) and Warm Tan (#B88A6B) palette.
Use Caveat font for playful, hand-written greetings (e.g., 'Your Quiet Corner in the Chaos' on the dashboard empty state). Use Figtree for all operational data (prices, names, statuses).
Kanban board should scroll horizontally on mobile devices, with snap points if possible.
Implement the specific color-coded status badges precisely as defined in colors.kanban_status to ensure fast visual scanning by the staff.
Kitchen View should strictly be a large-card grid, prioritizing 'Oldest First' active orders. Use large fonts for item quantities.
Ensure Shadcn components (Dialogs, Selects, Inputs) are heavily customized to remove the 'Vercel-look'. Round the corners to xl/2xl and use the earthy border colors.
